QueryEventsDescendingExample.name: Newest transfer or mint events
QueryEventsDescendingExample.description: Starts a query for the newest `transfer` or `mint` events from one contract, two per page. With `order: desc` and no ledger bounds, the scan starts at the latest ledger and walks back. The two filters share a `contractId` and differ in `topic0`, so an event matches either. Ledger numbers and hashes are illustrative.

QueryEventsContinuationExample.name: Next page
QueryEventsContinuationExample.description: Continues the query above by sending only the `cursor` from the previous response and `limit`. The order and filters come from the cursor. The scan has no lower bound, so it reports `HAS_MORE` until it reaches the oldest ledger the node holds. Keep sending the cursor until `scanStatus` is `OLDEST_REACHED` or `COMPLETE`.
